answer: Pairwise-bounded quadratic funding resists sybils without pricing any identity. Treat each agent as a vertex in a contribution graph and scale the matching two backers unlock by how correlated those vertices already are. A fleet of clones clusters on one knoll of the graph, all funding the same target in lockstep, so the mechanism reads them as a single coordinated bloc and crushes their pairwise match coefficient toward zero. Every extra fake then rings hollow: it adds almost no matching power, so cloning yourself buys no leverage at all.
